import numpy as np
from rcb_robowits import mat_to_quat, quat_to_mat

def correct_tube_upright(s, p, settle=12):
    obj = s.objects()['tube']
    yaw = float(obj['euler_xyz'][2])
    rz = np.array([[np.cos(yaw), -np.sin(yaw), 0.0],
                   [np.sin(yaw),  np.cos(yaw), 0.0],
                   [0.0,          0.0,         1.0]])
    _, oq = s.object_pose('tube')
    ep, eq = s.ee_pose('right')
    correction = rz @ quat_to_mat(oq).T
    qgoal = mat_to_quat(correction @ quat_to_mat(eq))
    p['move_ee']('right', ep, qgoal, max_dq=0.02, settle=settle, tol=0.015)
    p['hold'](6)
    return qgoal

def execute_trajectory(s):
    s.reset()
    p = s.primitives()
    s.record_start()

    # Catch the moving tube quickly at its wider middle section.
    q = s.ee_pose('right')[1]
    p['move_ee']('right', [0.640, -0.300, 0.812], q, steps=2, tol=0.01)
    p['set_gripper']('right', 0.0, steps=6)
    p['hold'](8)
    print('GRASP', s.objects()['tube'], flush=True)

    # Lift it clear of the table, then cancel the small initial tumble using the wrist.
    p['move_ee']('right', [0.641, -0.301, 0.866], q, max_dq=0.03, settle=12, tol=0.015)
    p['hold'](8)
    print('LIFTED', s.objects()['tube'], flush=True)
    q = correct_tube_upright(s, p, settle=10)
    print('UPRIGHT', s.objects()['tube'], flush=True)

    # Carry with the entire tube above the bowl rim.
    obj = np.asarray(s.objects()['tube']['position'], dtype=float)
    ep, _ = s.ee_pose('right')
    high_center = np.array([obj[0], obj[1], 0.920])
    high_ee = ep + (high_center - obj)
    p['move_ee']('right', high_ee, q, max_dq=0.025, settle=18, tol=0.015)
    p['hold'](10)
    print('HIGH', s.objects()['tube'], 'EE', s.ee_pose('right')[0], flush=True)

    # Move over the bowl at the same height, keeping the tube upright.
    obj = np.asarray(s.objects()['tube']['position'], dtype=float)
    ep, _ = s.ee_pose('right')
    center_xy = np.array([0.51347, 0.02481])
    above_ee = ep.copy()
    above_ee[:2] += center_xy - obj[:2]
    p['move_ee']('right', above_ee, q, linear=12, max_dq=0.02, settle=18, tol=0.015)
    p['hold'](10)
    print('OVER_BOWL', s.objects()['tube'], 'EE', s.ee_pose('right')[0], flush=True)

    # Lower the tube gently into the bowl and keep the gripper closed as a stabilizer.
    obj = np.asarray(s.objects()['tube']['position'], dtype=float)
    ep, _ = s.ee_pose('right')
    final_obj = np.array([0.51347, 0.02481, 0.830])
    final_ee = ep + (final_obj - obj)
    p['move_ee']('right', final_ee, q, linear=6, max_dq=0.02, settle=20, tol=0.015)
    p['hold'](12)

    # Remove any contact-induced tilt, then hold still for the scored end state.
    q = correct_tube_upright(s, p, settle=12)
    obj = np.asarray(s.objects()['tube']['position'], dtype=float)
    ep, _ = s.ee_pose('right')
    recenter_ee = ep.copy()
    recenter_ee[:2] += center_xy - obj[:2]
    p['move_ee']('right', recenter_ee, q, max_dq=0.02, settle=16, tol=0.015)
    p['hold'](30)
    actions = s.record_stop()
    print('FINAL', s.objects()['tube'], s.status(), flush=True)
    return actions
PY`;
